description: This file defines the BidiNetworkManager class and related classes/functions for managing network requests and responses in a browser automation context, including request interception, authentication, and event handling within the Playwright project.

classes.name: BidiNetworkManager
classes.description: Manages network requests, responses, and interception using the BiDi protocol within a browser automation context.

classes.name: BidiRequest
classes.description: Represents a network request in the BiDi protocol context.

classes.name: BidiRouteImpl
classes.description: Implements network route delegation, allowing request continuation, fulfillment, or abortion.

methods.name: _onBeforeRequestSent
methods.description: Handles the event before a network request is sent, managing request creation and interception.

methods.name: _onResponseStarted
methods.description: Handles the event when a response starts, creating a response object and reporting it.

methods.name: _onResponseCompleted
methods.description: Handles the event when a response completes, finalizing request and response data.

methods.name: _onFetchError
methods.description: Handles fetch errors, marking requests as failed.

methods.name: _onAuthRequired
methods.description: Handles authentication challenges, providing credentials if available.

methods.name: _deleteRequest
methods.description: Deletes a request from internal tracking.

methods.name: _updateProtocolRequestInterception
methods.description: Updates the protocol-level request interception settings.

methods.name: continue
methods.description: Continues a request with optional overrides.

methods.name: fulfill
methods.description: Provides a response to fulfill a request.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts a request with an error code.
